lines.text: Hi! This is Zidane Books. Think of it like a magic notebook for our business. It remembers everything, so we don't have to.
lines.caption: A magic notebook for our business

lines.text: Every person has their own key. Sales, Operations, Accounts, and the Director. Each one only sees their own work.
lines.caption: Everyone has their own login

lines.text: When you open it, the first page tells you one thing. What do I need to do today? Red boxes mean, do it now!
lines.caption: First page = what to do today

lines.text: A customer calls and asks for rice. Sales writes it down. Who is the customer, what do they want, and how many. Done!
lines.caption: Sales writes down the order

lines.text: The customer says yes! So Sales presses, Create Job. A job is like a ticket that goes to the Operations team.
lines.caption: Customer said yes → Create Job

lines.text: Operations opens the new job, and presses Start procurement. That means, let's go and buy the things!
lines.caption: Operations starts buying

lines.text: This page shows everything we need to buy, for all the jobs together. We bought the rice, so we press Bought.
lines.caption: What to buy → Bought

lines.text: Then Operations adds the supplier's bill, so we know what it cost us. The job's items fill in all by themselves.
lines.caption: Add the supplier's bill

lines.text: Everything is ready! Operations presses Material ready, and Sales finds out straight away.
lines.caption: Material ready → Sales knows

lines.text: Sales makes a delivery challan. The driver takes the goods, the customer signs it, and we mark it signed.
lines.caption: Delivery challan → customer signs

lines.text: Now Sales makes the invoice with one click. It already knows the items and the prices!
lines.caption: Invoice in one click

lines.text: Accounts checks the invoice, presses Verify, and writes down the money when the customer pays.
lines.caption: Accounts checks and gets paid

lines.text: And the Director can see the whole story. What we sold, what it cost, and how much profit we made.
lines.caption: Director sees the profit

lines.text: That's it! Ask, buy, deliver, and get paid. Zidane Books keeps everything neat and tidy.
lines.caption: Ask → Buy → Deliver → Get paid
